title: A Variational Surrogate Approach to Finite-Horizon Quantum Control via Hardware-Efficient Ansatz
summary: We present a variational quantum framework for finite-horizon quantum control based on hardware-efficient ansätze. The objective is to steer a quantum system from a given initial state to a desired target state over a fixed time horizon by minimizing a terminal cost defined in terms of state fidelity.
